text:
I can build your Athens version of the site in 48 hours by recreating the same layout, structure, and content flow from the example while swapping the branding and copy to match Athens.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I have 7 years of experience building websites and full stack applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. For a project like this, I’d keep the implementation focused and efficient so you get a clean, responsive website that matches the reference design closely and is ready within your deadline.

One relevant project was a Monthly statement PDF generator for Alder Property Group in real estate. I built a queue-based system with Node.js, BullMQ, Redis, Puppeteer, and AWS S3 that rendered owner statements to PDF overnight instead of on request. The result was 12k statements a month, and request timeouts went from daily to none. That project reflects the kind of attention I bring to building dependable, polished front ends and handling implementation details cleanly under time pressure.

For your website, I can:
- Recreate the design and page structure from the example
- Replace LA with Athens throughout the content
- Build a responsive, polished site that works well on desktop and mobile
- Deliver quickly within the 48-hour window

If you’d like, I can start immediately and keep the process simple: review the reference, confirm any Athens-specific text, build the site, and hand it over ready to use.
